<title level="1" right="Cantrip 1" pfs="Standard">
[Void Warp](/Spells.aspx?ID=1745)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cantrip" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=22" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Void" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=510" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 366

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet

**Target** 1 living creature
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
Fortitude

</row>

</column>

---

You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) until the start of your next turn.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.
name: Void Warp
